subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be an opt-in queue mode or policy instead of changing the existing steer default?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the requested behavior is not implemented, but choosing abort/capture/resume semantics affects provider contracts, tool-result pairing, transcript state, channel behavior, and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new explicit mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while keeping current boundary steering as the default.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Decide that steer remains a model-boundary feature and close or narrow the broad soft-steer request after active-run ingress issues are resolved.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing steer more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for workflows that depend on current boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new explicit mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while keeping current boundary steering as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed this issue as a product/runtime lifecycle decision and have adjacent queue/reply ownership history in the reviewed context.
